title: Quick access to your own practice
description: A recording chosen in advance opens in one action, with the sound and the playback position saved.

blocks.text: In a moment of strong agitation it can be hard to choose material again. A familiar route prepared in advance helps here.

quote.text: I like meditation apps, but when I’m having a panic attack I don’t want to have to dig through an app to find the paced breathing exercise. When I open this app, the breathing circle is right now.

blocks.text: Offer to save a personal recording, download it and check that it launches from a quick shortcut. Keep a pause and an exit alongside.
Do not call the shortcut first aid and do not promise that a panic attack will stop. Its job is access to the material the listener themselves finds suitable.
